scope_rule: All 24 primary attractions are strictly <=60 min by subway/bus/walking from every audited hotel in that city. Optional iconic >60 min excursions (e.g. Mutianyu Great Wall, Lantau Tian Tan Buddha) are flagged separately as excursions rather than primary city-hotel items.

activities.name: The Bund Waterfront Promenade
activities.closed_exceptions: None (Heavy evening foot traffic during Lantern Festival Sat Feb 20, 2027)
activities.transit_summary: 1–2 min walk from Fairmont, Peninsula & Waldorf Bund; 15–22 min Line 2 from People's Sq, Upper House & Jing'an.
activities.booking_tip: Best paired before/after Rockbund or South Bund Michelin dinners.

activities.name: Yu Garden (Classical Ming Garden)
activities.closed_exceptions: Closed Mondays (excl. national holidays) — avoid Mon Feb 15/22, Mar 1/8/15/22! Lantern Fair crowd peak Sat Feb 20 evening.
activities.transit_summary: 12–15 min walk/Line 10 from Bund hotels; 18 min direct Line 14 from Jing'an hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Right next to Nanxiang Steamed Bun; reserve garden ticket on WeChat/Trip.com.

activities.name: Shanghai Museum (People's Sq & East Wing)
activities.open_days: People's Sq: Tue–Sun | East Wing: Wed–Mon
activities.closed_exceptions: People's Sq closed Mondays; East Wing closed Tuesdays — smart split lets you visit East Wing on a Monday!
activities.transit_summary: 8–10 min walk/1 stop from Atour People's Sq & Upper House; 15–19 min Line 2 from Jing'an & Bund.
activities.booking_tip: Book free passport slot up to 7–14 days ahead; East Wing (Line 2 Science & Tech Museum) is open Mondays when most museums close.

activities.name: Shanghai Tower 118F Top of Shanghai Observatory
activities.closed_exceptions: None (Clear-visibility check before buying day-of slot)
activities.transit_summary: 14–16 min direct Line 2/14 to Lujiazui from Fairmont, Peninsula & Upper House; 20–24 min from Jing'an & Waldorf.
activities.booking_tip: Bring passport for entry; go ~17:00 for sunset + Bund lights.

activities.name: Jing'an Temple
activities.closed_exceptions: Festival dates (e.g., Lunar 1st/15th including Lantern Festival Sat Feb 20, 2027) raise ticket from ¥50 to ¥100 and bring heavy morning crowds.
activities.transit_summary: 2–5 min walk from PuLi & Kunlun; 11 min Line 2 from Upper House; 16–25 min from People's Sq & Bund.
activities.booking_tip: Golden roof lights glow after sunset outside even past 17:00 temple entry.

activities.name: Jade Buddha Temple
activities.closed_exceptions: Lunar 1st/15th (including Feb 20) very crowded early morning
activities.transit_summary: 15–18 min via Line 7 Changshou Rd from Kunlun, PuLi & Upper House; 22–32 min from People's Sq & Bund.
activities.booking_tip: Great Monday sightseeing stop when museums & Yu Garden are closed.

activities.name: West Bund Museum & Long Museum (West Bund)
activities.hours: West Bund Museum 11:00–18:00 | Long Museum winter (Nov–Mar) Tue–Thu 10:00–17:30, Fri–Sun 10:00–20:00
activities.closed_exceptions: Both closed Mondays (verify seasonal exhibition swaps)
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: ¥120–440 CNY combined exhibitions (Long ¥60–220/pp; West Bund Centre ~¥70–160)
activities.transit_summary: 22 min direct Line 12 from Upper House; 25–34 min via Line 7/11/12 across SH hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Also follow @thelongmuseum on IG; riverside walk links both galleries seamlessly.

activities.name: Former French Concession (Wukang Mansion & Anfu Rd)
activities.closed_exceptions: None — ideal Monday outdoor itinerary
activities.transit_summary: 14–16 min from Kunlun, PuLi & Upper House; 18–26 min from People's Sq & Bund.
activities.booking_tip: Walk Wukang Rd -> Anfu Rd -> Changle Rd -> Jing'an or Ji Pin Court.

activities.name: The Palace Museum (Forbidden City)
activities.closed_exceptions: Closed Mondays year-round! Strict real-name passport timed entry (tickets release 7 days prior 20:00 CST); Two Sessions Mar security checkpoints around Tiananmen.
activities.transit_summary: 10–15 min walk from MO Wangfujing & Waldorf BJ; 16–22 min from Park Plaza & Atour Beixinqiao.
activities.booking_tip: Approach via Donghua Gate (east moat) to skip heavy Tiananmen security queues; exit north into Jingshan Park!

activities.name: Temple of Heaven (Tiantan Park)
activities.closed_exceptions: Inner halls (Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests) closed Mondays — book through-ticket on Tue–Sun!
activities.transit_summary: Direct Line 5 south to Tiantan East Gate: 14 min from Park Plaza, 18–22 min from Waldorf, MO & Atour.
activities.booking_tip: Visit 07:30–09:00 to see morning taiji/shuttlecock locals before 08:00 hall opening.

activities.name: Lama Temple (Yonghegong)
activities.closed_exceptions: Open Mondays! Very crowded on Sat Feb 20, 2027 (Lantern Festival / 15th lunar day).
activities.transit_summary: 10 min walk from Atour Beixinqiao; 15–21 min direct Line 5 north from Wangfujing hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Adjacent to 2* King's Joy on Wudaoying Hutong; ideal Monday morning stop.

activities.name: Summer Palace (Yiheyuan)
activities.closed_exceptions: Interior halls (Foxiang Ge, Suzhou St) closed Mondays; Kunming Lake often partially frozen in mid-Feb (cold winds — dress warm!).
activities.transit_summary: 50–55 min subway (Line 5/1/8 -> Line 4 Beigongmen) across all 4 core BJ hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Use Beigongmen (North Palace Gate) on Line 4 for direct access to Tower of Buddhist Incense.

activities.name: National Museum of China
activities.closed_exceptions: Closed Mondays; mandatory free real-name passport booking 1–7 days ahead; Two Sessions (~Mar 4–14) may trigger temporary security closures.
activities.transit_summary: 11–18 min via Line 1 Tiananmen East from MO, Waldorf & Park Plaza; 25 min from Atour Beixinqiao.
activities.booking_tip: Allow 30+ min buffer for Tiananmen Square security perimeter checks.

activities.name: Jingshan Park (Imperial Hill Panorama)
activities.closed_exceptions: Open Mondays! Even when Forbidden City closes on Monday, climb Jingshan Hill to look down across the golden roofs.
activities.transit_summary: 15–22 min walk/bus/taxi across all 4 Dongcheng hotels.
activities.booking_tip: 10-minute climb to Wanchun Pavilion gives Beijing's best 360-degree skyline sunset view.

activities.name: Shichahai Lakes, Hutongs & Bell and Drum Towers
activities.hours: Lakes/Hutongs 24h | Drum & Bell Towers winter 09:30–16:30 (Drum performances hourly)
activities.closed_exceptions: Open Mondays — ideal Monday itinerary alongside No. 69 Fangzhuanchang.
activities.transit_summary: 14–20 min via Line 8/5 from Waldorf, Atour Beixinqiao, MO Wangfujing & Park Plaza.
activities.booking_tip: Ice skating on Houhai often open in mid-Feb cold snaps (verify warm-thaw safety).

activities.name: 798 Art District
activities.closed_exceptions: Major private galleries including UCCA close Mondays — go Tue–Sun!
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: ¥0 CNY district / ~¥120–200 CNY paid special exhibitions
activities.transit_summary: 35–45 min via Line 5/Airport Express->Line 14 (Jiangtai / Wangjing South) from all 4 BJ hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Combine afternoon at 798 with Chaoyang 3* dinner (Xin Rong Ji / Chao Shang Chao) nearby.

activities.name: The Peak Tram & Sky Terrace 428
activities.hours: Peak Tram 07:30–23:00 | Sky Terrace 428 Mon–Fri 10:00–22:00, Sat–Sun/PH 08:00–22:00
activities.closed_exceptions: None (Heavy sunset queues 16:30–18:30; pre-book combo or go 09:00/20:00)
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: HK$364 return+Sky Terrace combo (2 × HK$182) | Tram-only HK$232 (2 × HK$116)
activities.transit_summary: 8 min walk from MO HK; 18–22 min from iclub SW, Hyatt TST & HIE CWB.
activities.booking_tip: Take Peak Tram UP and Bus 15 / walk down via Lugard Rd if queues build.

activities.name: Star Ferry & Avenue of Stars Promenade
activities.hours: Ferries ~06:30–23:30 (Central–TST & Wan Chai–TST) | Avenue of Stars 24h
activities.closed_exceptions: None — Symphony of Lights daily 20:00.
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: HK$10–13 round/one-way upper deck (HK$5.00 wkdy / HK$6.50 wknd per ride)
activities.transit_summary: 5–6 min walk from MO HK & Hyatt TST; 15–18 min MTR from iclub SW & HIE CWB.
activities.booking_tip: Upper deck bow seats at sunset cost under $1 USD per adult.

activities.name: M+ Museum (West Kowloon)
activities.closed_exceptions: Closed Mondays (avoid Mon Feb 15/22, Mar 1/8/15/22!)
activities.transit_summary: 16–22 min via Kowloon/Austin MTR + WestK park bridge across all 4 HK hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Notice smart split: M+ closes Mondays while neighbor HK Palace Museum closes Tuesdays!

activities.name: Hong Kong Palace Museum (HKPM)
activities.closed_exceptions: Closed Tuesdays (open Mondays — perfect Mon cultural visit!).
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: HK$140 general galleries 1–7 (2 × HK$70; special exhibits extra)
activities.transit_summary: 18–26 min via Kowloon MTR + WestK shuttle/walk across all 4 HK hotels.
activities.booking_tip: Pairs directly with lunch/dinner at 2* Tin Lung Heen one stop away at ICC.

activities.name: Tai Kwun (Central Police Station Heritage & Art)
activities.closed_exceptions: Courtyard open daily incl. Mondays; check gallery rotation Mondays.
activities.transit_summary: 8 min Mid-Levels escalator walk from MO HK; 12–19 min from iclub SW, Hyatt TST & HIE CWB.
activities.booking_tip: Steps from Yat Lok & Kau Kee via Mid-Levels Escalator.

activities.name: Man Mo Temple & Hollywood Road Antique Walk
activities.closed_exceptions: None (Busy during Lantern Festival Sat Feb 20, 2027)
activities.transit_summary: 6 min walk from iclub Sheung Wan; 12–20 min from MO HK, Hyatt TST & HIE CWB.
activities.booking_tip: Giant incense coils make mornings atmospheric; 4 min walk down to Kau Kee.

activities.name: Nan Lian Garden & Chi Lin Nunnery
activities.hours: Nan Lian Garden 07:00–21:00 | Chi Lin Nunnery 09:00–16:30
activities.closed_exceptions: Open daily incl. Mondays — peaceful contrast to Central/TST skyscrapers.
activities.transit_summary: 18 min direct Tuen Ma Line from Hyatt TST; 26–30 min from HK Island hotels (Diamond Hill Exit C2).
activities.booking_tip: Vegetarian tea-house lunch inside the waterfall pavilion is serene.

activities.name: Temple Street Night Market
activities.closed_exceptions: None
activities.ticket_local_2_adults: HK$0 entry (~HK$120–240 optional claypot rice / snacks for 2)
activities.transit_summary: 7 min (1 stop MTR) from Hyatt TST; 13–19 min from Central, Sheung Wan & Causeway Bay.
activities.booking_tip: Pair with Bib Gourmand Mak Man Kee wonton noodles right next door in Jordan.

over_60_min_excursions.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
over_60_min_excursions.transit: ~85–110 min private car / coach each way
over_60_min_excursions.note: Must-do half/full-day trip outside <=60 min core filter; clear crisp February air but freezing wind.

over_60_min_excursions.name: Ngong Ping 360 & Tian Tan Buddha (Lantau)
over_60_min_excursions.transit: ~60–70 min MTR Tung Chung Line + 25 min cable car
over_60_min_excursions.note: Check Ngong Ping 360 annual ropeway maintenance schedule in Feb/Mar before booking.

over_60_min_excursions.name: Zhujiajiao Water Town
over_60_min_excursions.note: Easy scenic canal half-day trip on Line 17 outside urban <=60 min matrix.
